ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: In the rhombus $ABCD$, $E$ and $F$ are respectively on $BC$ and $DC$, with $BE=DF$ and $AE=AB$. If $\angle EAF=30^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle D$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since quadrilateral $ABCD$ is a rhombus,\\
it follows that $AB=AD$, $\angle B=\angle D$,\\
Given that $BE=DF$,\\
it follows that $\triangle ABE\cong \triangle ADF$ (SAS),\\
therefore, $\angle BAE=\angle DAF$,\\
Let $\angle BAE=\angle DAF=x$,\\
Since $\angle EAF=30^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle BAD=2x+30^\circ$,\\
Given that $AE=AB$,\\
it follows that $\angle B=\angle AEB=\frac{180^\circ-x}{2}$,\\
Since $\angle B+\angle BAD=180^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\frac{180^\circ-x}{2}+30^\circ+2x=180^\circ$,\\
Solving gives: $x=40^\circ$,\\
therefore, $\angle D=\angle B=\frac{180^\circ-40^\circ}{2}=\boxed{70^\circ}$;

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, ABCD is a rhombus, A is above, C is below, B is on the left side, and D is on the right side; E is located on side BC, and F is located on side DC. The order of the rays starting from point A is AB, AE, AF, AD, therefore ∠BAD is composed of three parts: ∠BAE, ∠EAF, and ∠FAD. Then reason: Because ABCD is a rhombus, AB=AD, and ∠B=∠D. Also because E is on BC and F is on DC, ∠ABE is equal to ∠B of the rhombus, and ∠ADF is equal to ∠D of the rhombus; then from BE=DF, it can be obtained that △ABE and △ADF satisfy SAS congruence. Therefore ∠BAE=∠DAF. Let ∠BAE=∠DAF=x. It is known that ∠EAF=30°, so ∠BAD=x+30°+x=2x+30°. Also because AE=AB, △ABE is an isosceles triangle, and the base angles ∠ABE=∠AEB=(180°-x)/2. Adjacent interior angles of a rhombus are supplementary, therefore ∠B+∠BAD=180°, that is, (180°-x)/2+(2x+30°)=180°. Solving gives 90°-x/2+2x+30°=180°, so 120°+3x/2=180°, x=40°. Thus ∠B=(180°-40°)/2=70°. Since opposite angles of a rhombus are equal, ∠D=∠B=70°.

From the text, use that ABCD is a rhombus, BE=DF, AE=AB, and angle EAF=30°. Since AB=AD in a rhombus and angle B equals angle D, triangles ABE and ADF are congruent by SAS: AB=AD, BE=DF, and the included angles at B and D are equal. Hence angle BAE=angle DAF; call each x. Then angle BAD=x+30°+x=2x+30°. Because AE=AB, triangle ABE is isosceles, so angle AEB=angle ABE=(180°-x)/2. In a rhombus, consecutive angles are supplementary, so angle ABE + angle BAD=180°. method.method_draft: Use a coordinate/vector-trigonometric model. From the image, take adjacent side vectors of the rhombus from A to B and from A to D, and let their common length be 1. Let alpha=angle BAD, so the desired angle D is 180°-alpha. Let u and v be unit vectors along AB and AD with u·v=cos alpha. Since E is on BC and F is on DC, write E=u+t v and F=v+t u, because BE=DF forces the same side fraction t on the two adjacent sides. The condition AE=AB=1 gives |u+t v|=1, so 1+t^2+2t cos alpha=1, hence t=-2 cos alpha. Also |F|=1 by the same expression. Now angle EAF is the angle between vectors E and F, so E·F=cos 30° because both have length 1. Compute E·F=2t+(1+t^2)cos alpha. Substitute t=-2 cos alpha to get E·F=4cos^3 alpha-3cos alpha=cos(3alpha). Thus cos(3alpha)=cos 30°. Since E and F lie on the actual sides, 0<t<1, so cos alpha is between -1/2 and 0 and alpha is between 90° and 120°. Therefore 3alpha is between 270° and 360°, and the compatible solution to cos(3alpha)=cos 30° is 3alpha=330°, so alpha=110°. Hence angle D=180°-110°=70°.
method.CoT_raw: 图像显示菱形 ABCD，其中 A 在上方，C 在下方，B 在左侧，D 在右侧；E 位于边 BC 上，F 位于边 DC 上，并画出了 AE 与 AF。现在按坐标/向量三角方法求解。设 A 为原点，取从 A 到 B 的单位向量为 u，从 A 到 D 的单位向量为 v，且 |u|=|v|=1。令 alpha=angle BAD，则 u·v=cos alpha。菱形中 C 的位置向量为 u+v。因为 E 在 BC 上，F 在 DC 上，可写 E=u+t v，F=v+t u；这里 BE=DF 使得二者在对应边上的比例相同，均为 t。由 AE=AB=1，得 |u+t v|=1。平方得 1+t^2+2t cos alpha=1，所以 t(t+2cos alpha)=0。由于 E 不在 B 点，取 t=-2cos alpha。同理 |F| 也等于 1。已知 angle EAF=30°，也就是向量 E 与 F 的夹角为 30°，且 |E|=|F|=1，因此 E·F=cos30°。计算 E·F=(u+t v)·(v+t u)=2t+(1+t^2)cos alpha。代入 t=-2cos alpha，得 E·F=4cos^3 alpha-3cos alpha=cos(3alpha)。于是 cos(3alpha)=cos30°。又因为 E、F 在线段实际内部，0<t<1，所以 0<-2cos alpha<1，即 -1/2<cos alpha<0，因此 90°<alpha<120°。于是 270°<3alpha<360°，在这个范围内满足 cos(3alpha)=cos30° 的是 3alpha=330°，所以 alpha=110°。菱形相邻内角互补，因此 angle D=180°-alpha=180°-110°=70°。

raw_record.original_question: In the rhombus $ABCD$, $E$ and $F$ are respectively on $BC$ and $DC$, with $BE=DF$ and $AE=AB$. If $\angle EAF=30^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle D$?
raw_record.answer:
\textbf{Solution:} Since quadrilateral $ABCD$ is a rhombus,\\
it follows that $AB=AD$, $\angle B=\angle D$,\\
Given that $BE=DF$,\\
it follows that $\triangle ABE\cong \triangle ADF$ (SAS),\\
therefore, $\angle BAE=\angle DAF$,\\
Let $\angle BAE=\angle DAF=x$,\\
Since $\angle EAF=30^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle BAD=2x+30^\circ$,\\
Given that $AE=AB$,\\
it follows that $\angle B=\angle AEB=\frac{180^\circ-x}{2}$,\\
Since $\angle B+\angle BAD=180^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\frac{180^\circ-x}{2}+30^\circ+2x=180^\circ$,\\
Solving gives: $x=40^\circ$,\\
therefore, $\angle D=\angle B=\frac{180^\circ-40^\circ}{2}=\boxed{70^\circ}$;
raw_record.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, ABCD is a rhombus, A is above, C is below, B is on the left side, and D is on the right side; E is located on side BC, and F is located on side DC. The order of the rays starting from point A is AB, AE, AF, AD, therefore ∠BAD is composed of three parts: ∠BAE, ∠EAF, and ∠FAD. Then reason: Because ABCD is a rhombus, AB=AD, and ∠B=∠D. Also because E is on BC and F is on DC, ∠ABE is equal to ∠B of the rhombus, and ∠ADF is equal to ∠D of the rhombus; then from BE=DF, it can be obtained that △ABE and △ADF satisfy SAS congruence. Therefore ∠BAE=∠DAF. Let ∠BAE=∠DAF=x. It is known that ∠EAF=30°, so ∠BAD=x+30°+x=2x+30°. Also because AE=AB, △ABE is an isosceles triangle, and the base angles ∠ABE=∠AEB=(180°-x)/2. Adjacent interior angles of a rhombus are supplementary, therefore ∠B+∠BAD=180°, that is, (180°-x)/2+(2x+30°)=180°. Solving gives 90°-x/2+2x+30°=180°, so 120°+3x/2=180°, x=40°. Thus ∠B=(180°-40°)/2=70°. Since opposite angles of a rhombus are equal, ∠D=∠B=70°.
